content.jointProblem: Can a Serbian retrieval pipeline combining script canonicalization, morphological normalization and incremental vocabulary handling reduce LinguaBot’s no-useful-result rate toward its below-5% target without a full re-index? The first experiment would compare these components against the existing Elasticsearch baseline on held-out support queries, explicitly testing transfer to banking and telecom terminology, within-word script mixing, and newly introduced vocabulary while measuring retrieval quality, latency and maintenance effort.

rationale.text: Dragić has directly relevant evidence in phoneme-based Serbian script canonicalization evaluated on query–document relevance judgments.

sources.quote: This paper presents a token canonicalization procedure in which each token is mapped to a phoneme sequence
We evaluated the approach on a manually annotated gold standard of 4 200 query–document relevance pairs

rationale.text: His work tests the interaction and ordering of Serbian morphological reduction and script normalization, directly addressing the task’s two coupled failure sources.

sources.quote: U ovom radu ispitujemo kako stemovanje i lematizacija interaguju s postupkom normalizacije skripte pri izgradnji pretražnog indeksa.
stemovanje posle normalizacije daje konzistentno bolje rezultate za sve tri kombinacije

rationale.text: His incremental indexing research provides a starting point for investigating updates, although it does not establish vocabulary-rule changes without re-indexing.

sources.quote: Kada tok vesti dolazi iz više izvora koji koriste različita pisma, inkrementalni indekser mora da normalizuje pismo svake pristigle stavke pre umetanja.

rationale.text: His production-load experiments provide relevant methods for evaluating deterministic normalization against selective neural fallback rather than assuming a heavier model is necessary.

sources.quote: A cascaded configuration — deterministic normalizer with neural fallback triggered only for out-of-vocabulary tokens — reaches MRR of 0.66
We measure mean reciprocal rank, P@5, and end-to-end latency at the 50th, 90th, and 99th percentiles

rationale.text: He has prior commercial experience adapting Serbian search, supporting a focused applied research collaboration.

sources.quote: sarađivao je s jednim novosadskim startapom iz oblasti legaltech-a na prilagođavanju pretražnog modula za srpske sudske odluke

constraints.text: The approach must handle Serbian inflection and script mixing, including within-word errors; normalizing only whole documents or maintaining manual synonym lists would not meet the stated need.

sources.quote: our users freely switch between Latin and Cyrillic script mid-sentence — sometimes mid-word in typos.
We need an approach that handles lemmatisation or indexing in a way that is accurate for Serbian
maintaining those lists manually does not scale as clients add new product terminology every quarter.

constraints.text: The prototype must work with the existing Elasticsearch retrieval system and support vocabulary updates without a full re-index.

sources.quote: Our current Elasticsearch setup uses a basic stemmer that was built for Croatian
can be updated when new vocabulary arrives without a full re-index.

constraints.text: Evaluation should use the company’s labelled query-response data and linguist validation; access to the underlying retrieval corpus and usable relevance judgments must be established.

sources.quote: We have a labelled query-response dataset of around 85,000 pairs across all clients
our two in-house linguists can annotate or validate proposed solutions.

constraints.text: Success criteria must operationalize the company’s below-5% miss-rate aspiration and manageable maintenance requirement; neither is an established outcome.

sources.quote: A good outcome is getting that 18% miss rate below 5% and keeping it there with a manageable maintenance process.

constraints.text: A testable prototype must fit the six-month window and approximately EUR 8,000 tooling/data budget; the overall collaboration budget remains unspecified.

sources.quote: Budget for tooling or data work is modest — around 8,000 EUR — and we want something testable within six months.

constraints.text: Scope must remain a small, research-focused engagement: Dragić reports two active projects and capacity for one smaller industrial contract or consultancy, but his start date and time allocation are unknown.

sources.quote: Trenutno je angažovan na dva aktivna projekta, ali ima kapaciteta za jedan manji industrijski ugovor ili konsultantski angažman.
nije zainteresovan za opšte projekte razvoja softvera bez istraživačke komponente.

risks: Transfer is unvalidated: legal, news, benchmark and encyclopedia retrieval results do not establish performance on short banking/telecom support queries or within-word mixed-script typos. These cases must be explicit strata in the first experiment.

Incremental insertion of normalized documents is not equivalent to changing morphological or canonicalization rules without re-indexing existing content. The update requirement could invalidate an otherwise accurate design.

Foreign names, abbreviations, alphanumeric product identifiers and new terminology may require exceptions; the researcher’s prior SME pilots also reported terminology-update needs. Maintenance could remain too manual.
Fixing morphology and script confusion may not reach the below-5% target because the company attributes only part of its current misses to those causes.

Elasticsearch-version compatibility, deployment resources, latency limits, data-sharing permissions and total project funding are unknown. Prior implementation and latency results do not establish feasibility in this environment.
Joint-project willingness is open, but actual availability and allocation within the six-month window are unknown despite the stated capacity for a small engagement.
questions: Can Dragić confirm a start date, time allocation and deliverables for a small joint project within six months, and who will own company-side engineering?
Can the team access the query-response pairs, corresponding knowledge-base documents and relevance labels? What anonymization, client permissions, hosting and retention rules apply?
How is 'no useful result' defined, at what retrieval cutoff, and can the 18% baseline be reproduced on a held-out set? Is below 5% a prototype acceptance condition or a longer-term aspiration?
Which Elasticsearch version, analyzers and index mappings are deployed? Does 'without a full re-index' permit query-time expansion, side dictionaries, additional fields or partial background updates?
What production hardware, peak query load and latency limits apply, and are external APIs or neural components permitted?
Does the EUR 8,000 cover only tooling/data work or also researcher fees? How much annotation time can the linguists commit, and what maintenance effort is acceptable?
Can the first experiment reserve unseen product terminology and linguist-validated within-word script-mixing cases, and test update behavior alongside accuracy and latency?
